news.headline: Lamar Jackson ruled out; Tyler Huntley starts for Baltimore
news.detail: Ravens coach Jesse Minter ruled Jackson out with an ankle injury, and he is on the Sunday inactive list (Oct 18). Tyler Huntley starts. The Browns will also be without RB Quinshon Judkins. The brief lists Jackson as BAL's QB.

news.headline: Eagles start Tanner McKee; Hurts placed on IR
news.detail: Jalen Hurts went on injured reserve with a calf blood clot and will miss at least four games. Tanner McKee makes his third career start against Carolina. Half the Eagles' starting lineup is out, per Heavy (Oct 16-18).

news.headline: Nacua healthy after 17-catch, 24-target Monday night
news.detail: Puka Nacua caught 17 passes for 138 yards on a Monday-night record 24 targets last week and is listed healthy. Matthew Stafford has four straight 300-yard games. Arizona's Budda Baker is questionable with a groin injury, and RB Jeremiyah Love is out (Oct 17-18).

news.headline: Rams CB Trent McDuffie questionable vs. Arizona
news.detail: The Rams' final injury report lists McDuffie (groin) and Kam Curl as questionable (Oct 17).

news.headline: Caleb Williams and Penix both active; Bears missing defenders
news.detail: Both QBs are playing on Sunday. Bears LB T.J. Edwards, CB Tyrique Stevenson and RB Kyle Monangai are inactive, and Montez Sweat is suspended. Bijan Robinson leads the NFL with 580 rushing yards. Drake London has 488 receiving yards.

news.headline: Chargers short-handed against Chiefs; Mahomes full practice
news.detail: Chargers tackles Joe Alt and Rashawn Slater, guard Kayode Awosika, safety Derwin James and CB Donte Jackson are out. Patrick Mahomes practiced fully with no game designation. Chiefs WR Rashee Rice and T Josh Simmons are out (Oct 16-17).

news.headline: Daniels plays for Washington; RB Croskey-Merritt out, Bosa out for SF
news.detail: Jayden Daniels practiced fully on his elbow and is expected to play. Commanders RB Croskey-Merritt is out with a groin injury. A 49ers injury-report headline says Nick Bosa is ruled out (Oct 17-18).

news.headline: Cowboys CB Porter expected to play; Packers D-line thin
news.detail: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) is expected to play, per ESPN's Jeremy Fowler. CB Cobie Durant is out and Ameer Speed is questionable. The Packers are without DTs Javon Hargrave and Jonathan Ford. Love threw for 367 yards last week.

news.headline: Giants lose RT Eluemunor; Winston starts against old team
news.detail: Giants RT Jermaine Eluemunor is inactive. Andrew Thomas and Abdul Carter were questionable. Jameis Winston is 2-0-1 as starter. Saints WR Chris Olave was listed questionable with an illness. Alvin Kamara is active.

news.headline: Colts TE Tyler Warren reported inactive
news.detail: A Yahoo Week 6 live-blog headline lists Tyler Warren as inactive. That could hurt Daniel Jones's offense. I did not confirm this with a second source.

NFL.recap: No graded results or post-game reviews were included in this run, so there is nothing to recap yet. The record so far was not provided either. The news check found one major change. Lamar Jackson is out for Baltimore, while the brief still lists him as the Ravens' QB.

College.recap: The model went 19 of 29 on winners, 16-10-2 against the spread and 19-9 on totals. Its average spread miss was 10.3 points against Vegas's 10.5, so it is about level with the line. Several misses came from game-flow luck. Memphis had 5 turnovers in a 31-17 loss to Tulane. Texas State scored 56 points on 9 trips inside the 40 against Colorado State.

lessons.lesson: When the model's total is 3+ points above Vegas's, the over has tended to hit.
lessons.evidence: 9 graded games had a model total 3+ above Vegas. The over won in 7 (Akron, Buffalo, Charlotte, Rutgers, Ball State, Pitt, Washington) and lost in 2 (Florida, LSU).
lessons.test: On past seasons, group games by model total minus Vegas total (0-3, 3-6, 6+) and check how often the over hits in each group. Need 20+ games per group.

lessons.lesson: Big misses often come from turnovers and finishing drives, which are hard to predict.
lessons.evidence: 6 reviewed games missed by 8+ points. 3 of them (Memphis, Texas State, East Carolina) had turnovers or drive finishing as a top reason.
lessons.test: On past seasons, compare model error with turnover margin and points per trip inside the 40. Check whether the misses are random or lean one way.

lessons.lesson: When the model picks a different favorite than Vegas, it has not done well yet.
lessons.evidence: 3 recent games had a different favorite. The model was right in 1 (Missouri State) and wrong in 2 (Cincinnati, Old Dominion). Sample is tiny.
lessons.test: On past seasons, list games where the model and Vegas disagree on the winner, then compare the model's win rate with Vegas's. Need 20+ games.
